extracted.intended_audience: amateur comedians and members of the public who want to submit jokes, photos, or videos to Laugh Factory
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for submitting user-generated comedy content (jokes, photos, videos) to the Laugh Factory website and the expectations/requirements implied by the submission page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted content types
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit your best content, jokes, photos, or videos to become an exclusive Laugh Factory member and have your content shared on our website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page explicitly invites jokes, photos, and videos as acceptable submission formats and indicates accepted content will be shared on the Laugh Factory site and may confer membership status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality expectation ('best' material)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The call-to-action emphasizes submitting your strongest material — i.e., pick your best jokes/content for consideration rather than rough drafts or low-effort posts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial review by 'Doctors of the Soul'
rubrics_metrics.description: So you thinK you’re funny? Let's see what our Doctors of the Soul have to say.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions will be reviewed/curated by Laugh Factory staff (referred to as 'Doctors of the Soul'), implying subjective editorial selection rather than automatic publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account/login and social connect for submission
rubrics_metrics.description: login to Laugh Factory / Connect with Facebook
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site includes login/account activation flows and offers Facebook connect; submission may require an account and granting access to certain Facebook data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facebook data access & permission notice
rubrics_metrics.description: We will access Facebook to get and use your email address, friend list, interests, likes and public profile, which includes your name, profile picture, user ID, age range, gender, networks, language, country and your other public info.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you connect via Facebook, the site will collect a broad set of profile and social data (and links to the Privacy Policy). The page also states: 'We'll never post to Facebook without your permission.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Cookie consent for site functionality/analytics
rubrics_metrics.description: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience, serve personalized content, and analyze our traffic. By clicking 'Accept All', you consent to our use of cookies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users are required to accept/decline cookies which affect personalization and analytics; implicit requirement for normal site experience and submission workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright / proprietary rights notice
rubrics_metrics.description: Copyright Notice: This website is protected by U.S. and International copyright laws. Reproduction and distribution of content, with or without modification, without written permission of Laugh Factory Inc., is prohibited. Laugh Factory, LaughFactory.com, the Laugh Factory logo, and all media posted have proprietary rights and are registered as trademarks and copyrights, of Laugh Factory Inc., or its affiliates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site asserts ownership and copyright over content on the site and prohibits reproduction without permission; submitters should be aware their posted media may be treated as site-owned/protected material and trademarked branding applies.
